Announcement.title: Announcement
Announcement.description: A message or policy HR publishes to the employees of an administration or of chosen departments, for a period, optionally asking each employee to confirm they read it (self-service-announcements-and-digest D1).

publiceren.description: Employees in the audience see the announcement from its start date.

intrekken.description: The announcement is no longer shown. Confirmations already given are kept.

title.title: Title
title.description: What the announcement is about, such as New expense policy 2027.

body.title: Text
body.description: The announcement itself. Attach a policy document to the announcement as a file.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Everyone in the administration, or only the departments you choose.

orgUnitIds.title: Departments
orgUnitIds.description: The departments that see it, including their teams. Only used when the audience is chosen departments.

publishFrom.title: Show from
publishFrom.description: The first day employees see it. Empty means from publication.

publishUntil.title: Show until
publishUntil.description: The last day employees see it. Empty means until it is withdrawn.

requiresConfirmation.title: Ask for confirmation
requiresConfirmation.description: Ask each employee to confirm they read it, so you can see who did.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: The administration whose employees it is for.

AnnouncementConfirmation.title: Announcement confirmation
AnnouncementConfirmation.description: One employee's confirmation that they read an announcement. There is at most one per employee per announcement (self-service-announcements-and-digest D1).

userId.title: Employee account
userId.description: The employee's Nextcloud account. Filled in automatically.

objects.title: Nieuwe declaratieregeling 2027
objects.body: Vanaf 1 januari 2027 geldt een nieuwe declaratieregeling. Lees het beleid in de bijlage en bevestig dat je het gelezen hebt.
